mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS activeLeadCount, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(l.next_action_time, TIMESTAMP(l.next_follow_time)) >= #{ctx.todayStart} AND COALESCE(l.next_action_time, TIMESTAMP(l.next_follow_time)) < #{ctx.tomorrowStart} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS todayActionCount, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(l.next_action_time, TIMESTAMP(l.next_follow_time)) < #{ctx.now} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdueCount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.next_action_time IS NULL AND l.next_follow_time IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS noNextActionCount, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(l.intent_level, ''), l.customer_level) IN ('A','B') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS highIntentCount, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(l.deal_amount, l.quoted_price) > 0 AND l.deal_probability BETWEEN 1 AND 100 THEN COALESCE(l.deal_amount, l.quoted_price) * l.deal_probability / 100 ELSE 0 END) AS weightedForecastAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(l.deal_amount, l.quoted_price) > 0 AND l.deal_probability BETWEEN 1 AND 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS forecastValidCount FROM crm_lead l WHERE l.status IN (1,2) AND l.owner_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT x.stageCode, COUNT(*) AS currentCount, SUM(CASE WHEN x.nextActionAt < #{ctx.now} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdueCount FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN l.status = 4 THEN 'INVALID' WHEN l.status = 3 THEN 'HANDOFF_DELIVERY' WHEN l.follow_status = '线索接收' THEN 'LEAD_RECEIVED' WHEN l.follow_status = '需求沟通' THEN 'NEEDS_COMMUNICATION' WHEN l.follow_status = '需求答疑' THEN 'NEEDS_CLARIFICATION' WHEN l.follow_status = '签单收款' THEN 'SIGNING_PAYMENT' WHEN l.follow_status = '移交结束交付' THEN 'HANDOFF_DELIVERY' WHEN l.status = 2 THEN 'NEEDS_COMMUNICATION' ELSE 'LEAD_RECEIVED' END AS stageCode, COALESCE(l.next_action_time, TIMESTAMP(l.next_follow_time)) AS nextActionAt FROM crm_lead l WHERE l.status IN (1,2,3)
) x GROUP BY x.stageCode

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.payable_amount),0) AS confirmedAmount, COUNT(*) AS confirmedOrderCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_type = 'new' THEN o.payable_amount ELSE 0 END),0) AS newBusinessAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_type = 'new' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS newBusinessCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_type = 'renew' THEN o.payable_amount ELSE 0 END),0) AS renewalAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_type = 'renew' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS renewalCount FROM biz_order o WHERE o.finance_confirm_time >= #{ctx.startTime} AND o.finance_confirm_time < #{ctx.endTimeExclusive}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS outstandingCount, COALESCE(SUM(r.arrears_amount),0) AS outstandingAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN r.due_date >= CURDATE() AND r.due_date <= #{ctx.dueSoonDate} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dueSoonCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.due_date >= CURDATE() AND r.due_date <= #{ctx.dueSoonDate} THEN r.arrears_amount ELSE 0 END),0) AS dueSoonAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN r.due_date < CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdueCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.due_date < CURDATE() THEN r.arrears_amount ELSE 0 END),0) AS overdueAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN r.collection_status = '承诺付款' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS promisedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.collection_status = '承诺付款' THEN r.arrears_amount ELSE 0 END),0) AS promisedAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN r.collection_status = '坏账风险' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS badRiskCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.collection_status = '坏账风险' THEN r.arrears_amount ELSE 0 END),0) AS badRiskAmount FROM fin_receivable_renewal r WHERE r.arrears_amount > 0

SELECT l.id AS leadId, l.company AS companyName, l.owner_id AS ownerId, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nickname,''), u.username) AS ownerName, l.dept_id AS deptId, d.dept_name AS deptName, CASE WHEN l.follow_status = '需求沟通' THEN 'NEEDS_COMMUNICATION' WHEN l.follow_status = '需求答疑' THEN 'NEEDS_CLARIFICATION' WHEN l.follow_status = '签单收款' THEN 'SIGNING_PAYMENT' WHEN l.follow_status = '移交结束交付' THEN 'HANDOFF_DELIVERY' WHEN l.status = 2 THEN 'NEEDS_COMMUNICATION' ELSE 'LEAD_RECEIVED' END AS stageCode, l.next_action_type AS nextActionType, COALESCE(l.next_action_time, TIMESTAMP(l.next_follow_time)) AS nextActionTime, l.last_follow_time AS lastFollowTime, COALESCE(l.deal_amount, l.quoted_price, 0) AS expectedAmount, CASE WHEN COALESCE(l.next_action_time, TIMESTAMP(l.next_follow_time)) < #{ctx.now} THEN 'OVERDUE' WHEN l.next_action_time IS NULL AND l.next_follow_time IS NULL THEN 'NO_ACTION' ELSE 'TODAY' END AS actionType, CASE WHEN COALESCE(l.next_action_time, TIMESTAMP(l.next_follow_time)) < #{ctx.now} THEN 'danger' WHEN l.next_action_time IS NULL AND l.next_follow_time IS NULL THEN 'warning' ELSE 'primary' END AS severity, DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), DATE(COALESCE(l.last_follow_time, l.create_time))) AS ageDays, COALESCE(NULLIF(l.intent_level, ''), l.customer_level) AS customerLevel FROM crm_lead l LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = l.owner_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = l.dept_id AND d.deleted = 0 WHERE l.status IN (1,2) AND l.owner_id IS NOT NULL AND (COALESCE(l.next_action_time, TIMESTAMP(l.next_follow_time)) < #{ctx.tomorrowStart} OR (l.next_action_time IS NULL AND l.next_follow_time IS NULL))
ORDER BY CASE WHEN COALESCE(l.next_action_time, TIMESTAMP(l.next_follow_time)) < #{ctx.now} THEN 1 WHEN l.next_action_time IS NULL AND l.next_follow_time IS NULL THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, COALESCE(l.next_action_time, TIMESTAMP(l.next_follow_time), l.create_time), COALESCE(l.deal_amount, l.quoted_price, 0) DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT l.owner_id AS ownerId, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nickname,''), u.username) AS ownerName, l.dept_id AS deptId, d.dept_name AS deptName, COUNT(*) AS activeLeadCount, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(l.next_action_time, TIMESTAMP(l.next_follow_time)) < #{ctx.now} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdueCount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.next_action_time IS NULL AND l.next_follow_time IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS noNextActionCount FROM crm_lead l LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = l.owner_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = l.dept_id AND d.deleted = 0 WHERE l.status IN (1,2) AND l.owner_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY l.owner_id, u.nickname, u.username, l.dept_id, d.dept_name

SELECT o.salesman_id AS ownerId, MAX(COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nickname,''), u.username, o.salesman_name)) AS ownerName, o.dept_id AS deptId, MAX(d.dept_name) AS deptName, COALESCE(SUM(o.payable_amount),0) AS confirmedAmount, COUNT(*) AS confirmedOrderCount FROM biz_order o LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = o.salesman_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = o.dept_id AND d.deleted = 0 WHERE o.finance_confirm_time >= #{ctx.startTime} AND o.finance_confirm_time < #{ctx.endTimeExclusive} AND o.salesman_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY o.salesman_id, o.dept_id

SELECT CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(l.source_platform), '') IS NOT NULL THEN LEFT(TRIM(l.source_platform), 32) WHEN l.source = 1 THEN '工商公开名单' WHEN l.source = 2 THEN '客户转介绍' WHEN l.source = 3 THEN '美团投流' WHEN l.source = 4 THEN '抖音投流' WHEN l.source = 5 THEN '线下来客' WHEN l.source = 6 THEN '其他投流' WHEN l.source = 7 THEN '名单采购/电销' WHEN l.source = 8 THEN '渠道合作' WHEN l.source = 9 THEN '私域二开' WHEN l.source = 10 THEN '其他' ELSE '未标注来源' END AS sourceName, COUNT(*) AS leadCount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS convertedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lostCount, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS conversionRate FROM crm_lead l WHERE l.create_time >= #{ctx.startTime} AND l.create_time < #{ctx.endTimeExclusive}
GROUP BY sourceName ORDER BY leadCount DESC, sourceName LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT CASE WHEN l.invalid_reason LIKE '%号码无效%' OR l.invalid_reason LIKE '%空号%' OR l.invalid_reason LIKE '%错号%' OR l.invalid_reason LIKE '%停机%' THEN '号码无效或异常' WHEN l.invalid_reason LIKE '%明确拒绝%' OR l.invalid_reason LIKE 'D类-%' THEN '无意向或明确拒绝' WHEN l.invalid_reason LIKE 'E类-%' THEN '无效客户' WHEN l.invalid_reason IS NULL OR TRIM(l.invalid_reason) = '' THEN '未填写原因' ELSE '其他已归档原因' END AS reason, COUNT(*) AS leadCount FROM crm_lead l WHERE l.status = 4 AND l.update_time >= #{ctx.startTime} AND l.update_time < #{ctx.endTimeExclusive}
GROUP BY reason ORDER BY leadCount DESC, reason LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT MIN(e.occurred_at) FROM crm_lead_stage_event e INNER JOIN crm_lead l ON l.id = e.lead_id WHERE e.tenant_id = #{ctx.tenantId} AND e.deleted = 0
